content: .{@-दर्शन@} {%a.%} pleasing to look at, of pleasing appearance, good-looking, lovely, handsome; अहो प्रियदर्शनः कुमारः <ls>U. 5</ls>; <ls>R. 1. 47</ls>; <ls>Ś. 3. 9</ls>; एवमुत्सुकोऽपि प्रियदर्शनो देवः <ls>Ś. 6</ls>. . ({@-नः@}) .²1 a parrot. .²2 a kind of date tree. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a prince of the Gandharvas; अवेहि गन्धर्वपतेस्तनूजं प्रियंवदं मां प्रियदर्शनस्य <ls>R. 5. 33</ls>. .²4 A plant growing on trees and stones (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>दगड्फूल</ns>). . ({@-नम्@}) the sight of a beloved object; अमृतं प्रियदर्शनम् <ls>Pt. 1. 128</ls>. . ({@-नी@}) a bird, Gracula religiosa.
